t: Investing in Distressed US Real Estate: Chapman and Cutler LLP
s: There are also opportunities to invest in distressed real estate as part of a sale conducted in a bankruptcy proceeding. In a voluntary bankruptcy case filed by the borrower, the borrower and lender cooperate to sell the property through a court-supervised and approved marketing process. Lenders may also file an involuntary bankruptcy case against the borrower to force a sale of its property over the borrower’s objection. The advantages to the purchaser of buying real estate in bankruptcy includes the ability to submit a stalking horse bid that entitles the purchaser to bid protections, which often include a break-up fee and expense reimbursement if the borrower pursues an alternative transaction.
